slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Use problem plus promise in two seconds—the viewer must know why to keep watching.
Show the result first, then rewind to how with a visual hook.
Controversy hooks work sparingly only when you deliver real value.

slides.heading: FIRST 3 SECONDS
slides.caption: State the payoff before you ask for attention.

slides.heading: HOW TO APPLY IT
steps: Write problem + promise in text and voice.
Show the result first, then rewind.
Draft ten hooks—shoot the best two.
Open with a face or moving object.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Read the hook out loud—if it sounds like an ad, rewrite it.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Slow intros that bury the promise after three seconds.
